interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint and signage to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to slow traffic speeds and create space for a sidewalk buffer or street trees.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the curb cut to defined entry and exit points to minimize the conflict area for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk material and level across the driveway to clearly indicate pedestrian priority and slow entering vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer/Bollards
interventions.description: Install bollards or a planting strip to physically separate the sidewalk from the parking area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to break up the crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Protection
interventions.description: Install bollards or high curbs to prevent vehicles from driving onto and parking on the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Midblock Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island and high-visibility signage to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow vehicle speeds and shorten the pedestrian crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street trees and furniture zone
interventions.description: Add a buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway to protect pedestrians and slow traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway entrance to the minimum necessary for safe vehicle access, thereby shortening the pedestrian crossing distance and slowing turning speeds.

interventions.title: Street trees and buffers
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees on the left side to create a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees or Planter Boxes
interventions.description: Install a furniture zone with trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: If there is pedestrian demand, install a marked midblock crossing with appropriate signage and potentially a refuge island to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees to create a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a buffer zone with street trees and lighting between the sidewalk and the curb to improve pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Mid-Block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island and RRFBs (Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons) to facilitate safe crossing to the institutional land use.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk and a raised pedestrian refuge island in the center turn lane to reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffering
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening or Pole Relocation
